content.title: Rare Earth Stocks Hit By U.S.-China Trade Deal, But Details Await
content.summary: China will delay its new rare earth export controls, buy U.S. soybeans and finalize a TikTok deal, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Sunday.  S&P 500 futures jumped early Monday, while rare earth stocks including MP Materials and USA Rare Earth tumbled on deal terms that seem to be about as good as could've been hoped for the U.S. side.  There are three possible explanations, though some combination of the three may be at play: 1) Beijing may have decided to backpedal after the stringent export controls announced on Oct. 9 sparked a backlash among major global trading partners.
